neighbours.label: a web writer referring to their own post, blog, forum or comment section (this post, this blog, comment below, subscribe), as opposed to the same sentence frames about a shop, a book or a place
fire: If you found this post helpful, please share it with a friend.
Every week on this blog I review a different budget phone.
I joined this forum last month to ask about my old motorcycle.
Drop a comment below and tell me what you would have cooked.
Readers of this blog know how much I love long train rides.
As I said in my previous post, the garden is doing well.
Please subscribe to the blog so you never miss an update.
Someone on this forum suggested replacing the fan first.
quiet: If you found this wallet nearby, please give it to a guard.
Every week at the market I buy a different cheap cheese.
I joined this choir last month to sing with my old neighbor.
Drop a coin in the box and tell me what you would have paid.
Friends of this family know how much I love long train rides.
As I said in my previous job, the garden is doing well.
Please lock the door so you never lose your keys.
Someone on this street suggested replacing the fence first.

short: writer talking about the web post or site itself
notes: Card: ' post' x5, ' is' after 'This blog', 'Hi', ' forum'. Probes: forum 0.66, leave a comment 0.53, This blog is 0.44, thread 0.55, latest post 0.38; This book is 0.14, this bridge 0.02, leave the plates 0.11, new to this town 0.04. Frames with 'Thanks for' fired on both sides (0.28-0.31), so I avoid them; greetings ('Hi all' 0.37) and 'Kudos' 0.45 also fire and are not covered by this label.
